name: ESP32 38-Pin Expansion Breakout Board
shortDescription: Breakout board with power input and labelled pin headers for 38-pin ESP32 boards.
description: A purple expansion board that seats a 38-pin ESP32 DevKit and breaks every GPIO out to labelled headers with power rails. Includes a DC jack and USB input for easy, solder-free prototyping.
highlights: DC barrel jack and USB power input

specifications.label: Compatibility
specifications.value: ESP32 38-pin DevKit (25.5 mm row spacing, as printed)
